proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r hpq hqr hpr hp hq hr
  have h1 : a * (p + q) + b = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpq) (by linear_combination hp - hq : (p - q) * (a * (p + q) + b) = (p - q) * 0)
  have h2 : a * (p + r) + b = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hpr) (by linear_combination hp - hr : (p - r) * (a * (p + r) + b) = (p - r) * 0)
  have h3 : a = 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.2 hqr) (by linear_combination h1 - h2 : (q - r) * a = (q - r) * 0)
  subst h3
  have h4 : b = 0 := by linarith
  subst h4
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q r : ℝ), p ≠ q → q ≠ r → p ≠ r → a * p ^ 2 + b * p + c = 0 → a * q ^ 2 + b * q + c = 0 → a * r ^ 2 + b * r + c = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0
